drawings.description: dans la marge de gauche, deux croquis de segments (un troisième, biffé, entre les deux, n'est pas décrit). En haut : un segment gradué portant au-dessus les marques « $-2i+2$ » et « $-i+1$ » et au-dessous « $-2i$ » et « $-i$ » --- les intervalles $[-2i+2, -i+1]$ et $[-2i, -i]$ portés sur la même droite. En bas : un segment gradué de quatre marques, « $-2$ », « $-1$ », « $0$ », « $1$ ».
drawings.kind: graded segments: the intervals [-2i, -i] and [-2i+2, -i+1]; the segment -2, -1, 0, 1
drawings.notes: Top: one line from the mark -2i to the mark -i, a tick near its left end under the label -2i+2, and beyond its right end, after a small gap, a short stroke ending in a tick under the label -i+1; the labels -2i+2 and -i+1 above, -2i and -i below, as on the page (the two intervals are thus drawn on one line, not one above the other as the note of the transcription says). Bottom: a segment with four ticks labelled -2, -1, 0, 1, each tick computed on the segment. Left out: the middle sketch, which is struck (a heavy bar, two short strokes ending in points, and digits, crossed by oblique strokes): struck material is not drawn. The struck middle sketch now has its own record, 04-2 (empty redraw). Redrawn 2026-11-12 (issue 128): to check again.

drawings.description: à droite, deux croquis : $T$, deux droites qui se coupent, portant les points $a$ et $b$, $T' = \{a, b\}$ ; et $\widetilde{T}$, les deux droites séparées, portant l'une $\{a\}$, l'autre $\{b\}$
drawings.kind: two crossing lines vs two separate lines
drawings.notes: Left: T, a brace over two lines that cross, carrying the points a and b; T' = {a, b} beside a brace. Right: T-tilde, a brace over two separate lines, one carrying {a}, the other {b}.

drawings.description: en bas à droite, un diagramme des couples $(p, q)$ admissibles : deux axes, et des croix en escalier --- sur l'axe horizontal et les trois rangées au-dessus, trois croix à gauche puis, plus à droite, trois, trois, deux et une croix ; en haut de l'axe vertical, deux croix à la hauteur $n-1$ et une à la hauteur $n$. L'axe vertical est gradué « $1$ », « $2$ », …, « $n-1$ », « $n$ », l'axe horizontal, à droite, « $n-3$ », « $n-2$ », « $n-1$ ».
drawings.kind: lattice diagram of the admissible (p, q)
drawings.notes: The two axes and the crosses as counted on the page, row by row from the horizontal axis upwards: 6 (three at the left, three at the right), 6, 5 (three and two), 4 (three and one); then, after a gap, 2 at height n-1 and 1 at height n on the vertical axis. Each cross is placed where he drew it (rows and columns are not regularised). Labels: 1, 2, n-1, n along the vertical axis; n-3, n-2, n-1 under the three right-hand columns. The gap between the left and the right columns, and between the lower rows and the two top rows, stands for the dots of « 1, 2, ..., n-1, n ». Redrawn 2026-11-12 (issue 128): to check again.

drawings.description: en bas à gauche, deux diagrammes des couples $(p, q)$, séparés par un trait vertical, sur un même axe horizontal. À gauche : un axe vertical gradué « $0$ », « $1$ », « $2$ », « $3$ », puis, au-dessus d'un trait horizontal, « $n-2$ », « $n-1$ », « $n$ » ; quatre croix sur chacune des rangées $0$ à $3$, puis quatre, deux et une croix aux rangées $n-2$, $n-1$, $n$. À droite : cinq croix sur l'axe et sur la rangée $1$, trois sur la rangée $2$, une sur la rangée $3$, les colonnes graduées « $2n-6$ », « $2n-5$ », « $2n-4$ », « $2n-3$ », « $2n-2$ ».
drawings.kind: two lattice diagrams of the pairs (p, q)
drawings.notes: As counted on the page. Left diagram: the vertical axis, the horizontal axis (which runs on through the right diagram), the horizontal stroke that separates the rows 0 to 3 from the rows n-2, n-1, n; crosses: 4, 4, 4, 4 on the rows 0, 1, 2, 3 (the first of each on the vertical axis), then 4, 2, 1 on the rows n-2, n-1, n. Right diagram, after the vertical separating stroke: 5 crosses on the axis, 5 on the row 1, 3 on the row 2, 1 on the row 3, the columns labelled 2n-6, 2n-5, 2n-4, 2n-3, 2n-2 from left to right. Each cross is placed where he drew it. Left out: the formulas at the upper right of the crop (E_2 terms of the table above). Redrawn 2026-11-12 (issue 128): to check again.

drawings.description: sous la formule, un croquis du terme $E_{2}$ : trois lignes horizontales, la plus haute marquée « 2 », fermées à droite par un trait vertical marqué « $N$ » ; des points sur les lignes, et deux flèches obliques $d_{2}$ descendant de la ligne 2 vers la ligne 1, puis de la ligne 1 vers la ligne 0, vers la droite
drawings.kind: sketch of the E_2 term: three rows with d_2 arrows
drawings.notes: Three horizontal lines, the top one marked 2, closed on the left by a vertical stroke and on the right by a vertical stroke; points on the lines and two oblique arrows d_2 going down to the right, from row 2 to row 1 and from row 1 to row 0. The "N" at the right stroke is not visible on the crop; it is placed after the transcription. The labels d_2 are not written beside the arrows on the page.

drawings.description: diagramme dessiné dans la marge inférieure gauche, en face des lignes sur la composition
drawings.kind: commutative diagram X, X', X'' with pi, f, g
drawings.notes: The diagram of the transcription in the lower left margin: X -pi- X, X' -pi'- X', X'' -pi''- X'', vertical arrows f and g. The horizontal pi strokes have no visible heads on the page.

drawings.description: dans la marge gauche, un premier dessin : $P \xrightarrow{u} Q$ avec une flèche $v$ en retour tracée au-dessus, et $P \to P' \simeq Q' \to Q$ ; en dessous, un second schéma plus confus où figurent $P' + P''$, $Q' + Q''$ et une flèche épaisse $P' \to Q'$, qui ne se laisse pas redessiner sûrement
drawings.kind: P -> Q with a return arrow v; second confused scheme
drawings.notes: Redrawn on tight crops. First drawing: P -u-> Q (thick arrow; Q is overwritten several times and drawn once), the return arrow v drawn above from the Q side to the P side, a thick arrow P -> P' (down), P' = Q' (the sign is overwritten, read as simeq after the transcription), a thick arrow Q' -> Q (up). Second, confused scheme: P' + P'' at the upper left, Q' + ... at the upper right (the Q'' of the transcription is cut by the margin of the crop and of the sheet, only Q' + is drawn), P' and Q' below; the thick arrows P' -> P'+P'' (up-left), a thick arrow from the left down to P', Q' -> P' (leftwards above), P' -> Q' (rightwards below, doubled and overwritten in the original, drawn once), Q' -> Q'+Q'' (up), a thin pencil arrow from Q'+Q'' down towards the arrow Q' -> P', and a broken thin arrow from P' up-left. Still differs: the directions in the second scheme are a reading (the transcription says it cannot be redrawn surely), the overwritings and a faint vertical stroke above the arrow Q' -> P' are left out. Redrawn 2026-11-09 (issue 128): to check again. Question settled by a machine pass on the facsimile, 2026-11-12 (page): the label at the upper right of the second scheme is Q' + Q'', written in full on the sheet (it was only cut by the first crop); drawn so. Not checked by a reader.

drawings.description: dans la marge de gauche, entre les deux croquis de segments, un troisième croquis, biffé : une barre épaisse prolongée à droite par deux traits terminés chacun par un point, avec au-dessous des chiffres raturés ; un trait oblique le barre.
drawings.notes: Struck on the page: the marks under the bar are scribbled over and a long oblique stroke crosses the sketch from the lower left. Struck material is not drawn, so the redraw is empty; the record is kept so that the figure can be retired or omitted. What can be seen on the 300 dpi crop: a heavy horizontal bar, continued to the right by a short stroke ending in a full point and, after a gap, by a second stroke ending in a full point; under the bar two scribbled-out marks (digits, not legible) and a heavy vertical tick with a short bar across it; the oblique stroke runs from below the left end of the bar up to the first of the two strokes. The two strokes ending in points, at the right, are not themselves crossed. It stands between the two sketches of 04-1 and looks like a first attempt at the graded segment drawn below it. Redrawn 2026-11-12 (issue 128): to check again.
